usedFor: Google Drive holds files and Chatwork carries chat, so “New or Updated File in specific folder” runs “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New or Updated File in specific folder” in Google Drive, then “Send Message” in Chatwork
bestTemplate.why: The room hears about each file dropped into a watched folder.

watchOut: That trigger fires on updates as well as new files, so one file can post twice.
